# Leaf Text — full page index

> Refine your mind. Your thoughts, secure and free. A free desktop app for reading and writing your own documents, on your own machine. Every canonical page, its human URL, its raw Markdown source, and a short description. Fetch the .md URLs for clean, JS-free text.

## Refine your mind.
- Page: https://leaftext.com/
- Markdown: https://leaftext.com/README.md
- Summary: Leaf Text is a free desktop app for reading and writing your own documents. Everything stays on your device, in plain files you own.

## Navigation
- Page: https://leaftext.com/docs/#/features/navigation
- Markdown: https://leaftext.com/docs/01-features/02-navigation.md
- Summary: The navigation model is simple from the outside and fairly careful under the hood. Each tab keeps its own file history and its own in-document scroll history.

## Library
- Page: https://leaftext.com/docs/#/features/library
- Markdown: https://leaftext.com/docs/01-features/03-library.md
- Summary: The library is the part of Leaf Text that helps you find documents, not just read the one you already opened. It lives in a left-side pane and is backed by a local indexer.

## Architecture

- Markdown: https://leaftext.com/docs/02-development/01-architecture.md
- Summary: Leaf Text is a single Rust binary that embeds a WebView (via wry) inside a native window (via tao). The Markdown rendering pipeline runs on the Rust side; the result is injected into the WebView as...

## Building
- Page: https://leaftext.com/docs/#/development/building
- Markdown: https://leaftext.com/docs/02-development/02-building.md
- Summary: Leaf Text is a Rust application (edition 2021). Building from source requires the Rust toolchain and the just command runner.

## Installation
- Page: https://leaftext.com/docs/#/installation
- Markdown: https://leaftext.com/docs/02-installation.md
- Summary: Leaf Text is free, and it ships ready to run on macOS and Windows. There's no account to create, no plugins to pick, and no runtime to install first — download it, open it, and it works.
